A '''yammosk''' was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Helska IV]] and was used by [[Prefect/Legends|Prefect]] [[Da'Gara]] and the [[Praetorite Vong]] to coordinate the movements of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yorik-et|coralskippers]]. However, the [[yammosk]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when Helska IV was [[Battle of Helska IV|shattered]] by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces.
